Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
For over 16 years, Hatsune Miku has been thrilling fans with her performances as a virtual diva. And now the world’s most famous digital superstar has added Secret Lair to her world tour! In the first of four amazing drops, Hatsune Miku brings her undeniable electricity to a set of cards featuring stunning art by illustrators from around the world. Inspired by the cherry blossoms and lightning of a Japanese spring, these cards will stun your table in English or Japanese.
Art by Jehan Choo, Justyna Dura, Mandy Jurgens, Dani Pendergast, Yuko Shimizu, and SYUTSURI.
Contents:
• 1x Shelter
• 1x Chandra’s Ignition as “Miku’s Spark”
• 1x Harmonize
• 1x Azusa, Lost but Seeking as “Miku, Lost but Singing”
• 1x Feather, the Redeemed as “Miku, the Renowned”
• 1x Inspiring Vantage
